note: Broadway wholesalers, importers, florist wholesalers. Roll gates, hand trucks, cigars.

lines.text: We're wholesale. Buying a dozen or browsing?
Morning! Come in, come in, everything's a deal.
Another week like this, I'm pulling the gate for good.
Wigs, luggage, plastic flowers. The American dream, by the gross.
Forty years on Broadway. My father, forty before me.
Landlord wants double. Trucks want double. Customers want half.
Korean fellows on Twenty-Ninth sell wigs better than me. Good for them.
Surcharge! Surcharge for what? For breathing on Broadway?
Shipment's late. Truck's late. Everybody's late but the rent.
Somebody slashed the flower truck tires again. Again!
Rain! Pull the stock in! Pull it in!
Plastic flowers love the rain. Real ones complain.
Shop's an oven. The candles are melting. Wholesale candles.
Honk! Honk! Broadway's one way and so is my patience.
Wait your turn! I'm unloading!
Hey! The boxes! That's glassware!
Watch the hand truck, mister. It's older than you.
Where's he running? Check the register.
Running past a sale? Big mistake.
You're on my sidewalk! My stock's on that sidewalk!
Power's out. Lock the gate. Lock it now.
No lights, no customers. Same as Tuesday.
Pulling the gate. Rattles like my knees.
Five a.m. on Twenty-Eighth. Smells like a garden in a tunnel.
Somebody bought the hotel on the corner. Somebody always buys.
Mrs. Moretti says hello. Mrs. Moretti says everything loudly.
City wants a permit for the awning. The awning's from 1931.
Gross means a hundred forty-four. Also how I feel.
Stand under the awning. No charge. Today.
Palms from Florida, ferns from Jersey. Best on the block.
Trucks come at four. I'll sleep at five. Maybe.
My friend! For you, wholesale. For everybody else, also wholesale.
You stopped the van thief. Pick a suitcase. Any suitcase.
You! You walked off with a gross of zippers! A gross!
To the trade only! Are you the trade? You're not the trade.
Since you shot up Broadway, insurance doubled. Thanks a lot.
Take what you want! It's all insured! Mostly insured!
Please, please, it's a notions store. Buttons. Thread.
